title: persea ferruginea
intro: Persea ferruginea, commonly known as Mexican bay or West Indian bay, is a species of plant in the family Lauraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving pain, due to its therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Persea ferruginea include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its antimicrobial and expectorant actions.
